**Finding: missing — insurance obligation absent (severity: low).**

- A full-text search for "insurance" returned nothing, and the miscellaneous run (Sections 13–30), Client covenants (sec-8) and indemnity (sec-12) contain no coverage requirement.
- TrueLink hosts the Client's Web Site and processes Client Content and consumer credit data via the Interface, so this is squarely a vendor that should carry coverage — the absence sits in walk-away territory, and the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is also unmet.
- Redline validated (`ok:true`) and submitted: new Section 31 inserted after Section 30 (Force Majeure) at the preferred limits — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request, surviving one year post-term.
- Noted for negotiation, not flagged: the survival clause in Section 25 (p0090) refers to "Sections 1 and 5 through 30," so if TrueLink accepts the new section we should conform that cross-reference to "through 31"; the clause's own one-year tail covers the point in the interim. The comment also offers the fallback limits (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) if TrueLink pushes back.
